headline: Day 17 usage reset announced
scope: Day 17 reset expected before October 22, 10:00 PST; eligible plans and usage windows were not specified.

announcement.text:
Day 17/ Bet you thought we forgot, but no, it’s reset day today.

Also good time to remind you to get Daybreak Blue access, it only takes 15 mins and you don’t want to have to do it in the middle of an incident.
announcement.translation:
第 17 天：你们肯定以为我们忘了，但没有，今天是重置日。

也趁这个机会提醒大家开通 Daybreak Blue 访问权限，只需要 15 分钟；你肯定不想在故障发生时才去办。

timingSource.translation: 将在明天 PST 上午 10 点前落地。

note: Completion has not been confirmed. At the timing reply's publication, the Pacific date was October 21; tomorrow is interpreted as October 22. The countdown uses the before-10am boundary under literal PST: October 22, 18:00 UTC (October 23, 02:00 UTC+8). If PST meant local PDT (UTC−7), the boundary would be October 22, 17:00 UTC (October 23, 01:00 UTC+8). This is an estimated deadline, not an exact reset time. Eligible plans and usage windows were not specified.
